meta.name: appstoreconnect/app-create
meta.description: Create an app record in App Store Connect (the "New App" dialog) for a bundle id already registered in the developer portal. The ASC API key cannot do this; your signed-in session can. Idempotent: if an app with the bundle id exists it is returned, not duplicated.

name.description: App name as shown on the App Store (at most 30 characters, unique across the store)

sku.description: Your own unique id for the app, e.g. example-app

locale.description: Primary language (default en-US), e.g. zh-Hans, ja, en-GB

meta.example: chrome-use site appstoreconnect/app-create --name "My App" --bundle_id com.example.app --sku example-app --locale zh-Hans

meta.name: appstoreconnect/apps
meta.description: List the apps in your App Store Connect account (name, bundle id, SKU, Apple ID). Runs as you, in your logged-in appstoreconnect.apple.com tab, through the same /iris/v1 API the web UI uses.

bundle_id.description: Only the app with this bundle id, e.g. com.example.app

meta.example: chrome-use site appstoreconnect/apps  |  chrome-use site appstoreconnect/apps --bundle_id com.example.app

meta.name: appstoreconnect/builds
meta.description: Recent builds of one app (newest first) with their processing state, so you can see when an upload is ready for TestFlight. Runs as you, in your logged-in appstoreconnect.apple.com tab.

meta.name: chatgpt/conversations
meta.description: List recent ChatGPT conversations, newest first

project.description: Only conversations in this project gizmo id (g-p-...)

meta.name: chatgpt/me
meta.description: Which ChatGPT account this browser is signed in as

meta.name: chatgpt/projects
meta.description: List ChatGPT Projects (folders) on this account

name.description: Only the project whose display name matches exactly

meta.name: csdn/article-publish
meta.description: Publish a Markdown article to CSDN (as 原创) as the signed-in user, or save it as a draft only

markdown.description: Full Markdown body (pass a file with --markdown @post.md)

tags.description: Comma-separated tag names. Only tags CSDN already has are used (max 5); accounts below blog level 3 cannot create tags, so the rest come back in skipped_tags. Publishing needs at least one

category.description: Your own 分类专栏 names, comma-separated (optional)

html.description: Rendered HTML for the body. Default: converted from markdown by the adapter

draft.description: true = only save a draft, do not publish (default false)

id.description: Existing article id to overwrite and publish (e.g. a draft the editor autosaved), instead of creating a new article

meta.example: chrome-use site csdn/article-publish --title "Hello" --markdown @post.md --summary "..." --tags "AI编程,人工智能,开源" --draft true

meta.name: douyin-creator/me
meta.description: Signed-in Douyin creator account: nickname, Douyin ID, followers, following, works count and total likes

meta.name: douyin-creator/works
meta.description: The signed-in account's own Douyin works, newest first, with plays/likes/comments/shares/collects and whether each is public or private. Private works report 0 plays.

limit.description: How many works to return (default 50, max 500)

visibility.description: all (default) | public | private — filters after fetching

cursor.description: Resume from a next_cursor a previous call returned (default: newest)

meta.name: douyin/delete
meta.description: Delete one of the signed-in account's own Douyin works from 作品管理 (creator.douyin.com), the way a person does it: find the work's card by its title, click 删除作品, confirm, then check work_list until the work is gone. Ids are kept as exact strings (19-digit ids do not round). Run with --until-done: the first run opens 作品管理 and the rerun deletes

aweme_id.description: The work's id (aweme_id or item_id, digits only), e.g. from douyin-creator/works

meta.name: douyin/update
meta.description: Change one of the signed-in account's own Douyin works: its scheduled publish time (--reschedule) and/or its text (--caption), through the creator center's own update calls

aweme_id.description: The work's id (aweme_id, digits only), e.g. from douyin-creator/works

reschedule.description: New publish time for a scheduled work: ISO 8601 (2026-10-20T20:00:00+08:00) or Unix seconds. Must be 2 hours to 14 days from now

caption.description: New text (正文) for the work

meta.name: juejin/article-publish
meta.description: Publish a Markdown article to Juejin (掘金) as the signed-in user, or save it as a draft only

markdown.description: Full Markdown body (pass a file with --markdown @post.md)

summary.description: 摘要 / brief_content. Juejin wants 50-100 characters to publish; derived from the body when omitted

tags.description: Comma-separated tag names, e.g. "Claude,AI编程,开源". Only tags Juejin already has are used (max 3); the rest come back in skipped_tags. Publishing needs at least one

category.description: Category name or id: 后端 前端 Android iOS 人工智能 开发工具 代码人生 阅读. Required to publish

draft.description: true = only create the draft, do not publish (default false)

meta.example: chrome-use site juejin/article-publish --title "Hello" --markdown @post.md --tags "AI编程,开源" --category 人工智能 --draft true

meta.name: sggit/pr-create
meta.description: Create a pull request on our self-hosted Gogs (sg-git.pwtk.cc). Runs as you, in your logged-in tab; posts the compare form the way the web UI does.
meta.example: chrome-use site sggit/pr-create --base main --head feat/leo/foo --title "feat: foo" --body "..."

meta.name: sggit/pr-list
meta.description: List pull requests on our self-hosted Gogs (sg-git.pwtk.cc). Runs as you, in your logged-in tab.

status.description: open | closed | all (default: open). Use --status, not --state (--state is a reserved chrome-use flag).

meta.example: chrome-use site sggit/pr-list ka-cn/super-admin closed  (positional)  |  chrome-use site sggit/pr-list --status all

meta.name: sggit/pr-merge
meta.description: Merge a pull request on our self-hosted Gogs (sg-git.pwtk.cc). Runs as you, in your logged-in tab; posts the merge form the way the web UI does. Intended for the dev PR (auto-merge); use with care on feature-test/main.

style.description: merge style: create_merge_commit (default) | rebase | squash — must be enabled on the server

meta.name: si12333/pension-payments
meta.description: 国家社会保险公共服务平台：企业职工基本养老保险缴费明细（全部参保地、全部年份）

region.description: 只查名称包含该文字的参保地，默认全部

meta.name: twitter/delete
meta.description: Delete one of the signed-in account's own tweets the way a person does: open the tweet, its ⋯ menu, Delete, confirm. Run with --until-done: the first run opens the tweet and the rerun deletes it

tweet.description: The tweet's status URL (https://x.com/name/status/123…) or its numeric id

meta.name: twitter/search
meta.description: 搜索推文

meta.name: twitter/thread
meta.description: 获取推文对话线程（原文 + 所有回复）

meta.name: twitter/user
meta.description: X profile counts (followers, following, posts, media, likes) and bio; without a handle, the signed-in account

meta.name: xiaohongshu-creator/me
meta.description: Signed-in Xiaohongshu creator account: profile counts plus the data center's 7/30-day summary

summary.description: Include the 7/30-day data-center summary (default true; false saves one request)

meta.name: xiaohongshu-creator/note-stats
meta.description: Data-center analytics (笔记数据) for one of your own notes: views, watch time, rates, engagement, traffic sources, audience

note_id.description: Note id, or a www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/<id> URL

audience.description: Include traffic sources and audience portrait (default true; false saves two requests)

meta.name: xiaohongshu-creator/notes
meta.description: Your published notes from the creator center note manager (笔记管理), with status and metrics

limit.description: How many notes to return (default 20, max 50; the server pages by 10)

page.description: Cursor: the next_page from a previous call (default 0, the first page)

tab.description: all (default) | published | reviewing | rejected | scheduled — or 全部/已发布/审核中/未通过/定时发布

meta.name: xiaohongshu/me
meta.description: Signed-in Xiaohongshu user on www.xiaohongshu.com with the profile counts (关注 / 粉丝 / 获赞与收藏), IP 属地 and the first page of their notes. No creator-center login needed

notes.description: How many of the newest notes to include (default 0, max 30: the profile page's first load)

meta.name: youtube-studio/channel
meta.description: The signed-in YouTube channel from Studio: subscribers, video count, total views, and its uploads (videos and Shorts, any visibility) with views/likes/comments

limit.description: How many uploads to list, newest first (default 30, max 500; 0 = channel totals only)

meta.name: zhihu/article-publish
meta.description: Publish a Markdown article to Zhihu 专栏 (知乎文章) as the signed-in user, or save it as a draft only

markdown.description: Full Markdown body (pass a file with --markdown @post.md); converted to Zhihu's HTML by the adapter

summary.description: Ignored: Zhihu builds the excerpt from the body. Accepted so one command line works for every platform

tags.description: Comma-separated topic (话题) names. Only topics Zhihu already has are bound (max 3); the rest come back in skipped_tags. Publishing needs at least one

html.description: Ready-made HTML body; overrides the markdown conversion

draft.description: true = only save a draft, do not publish (default false)

meta.example: chrome-use site zhihu/article-publish --title "Hello" --markdown @post.md --tags "Claude,AI编程,开源" --draft true
